recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core source follow-up is recommended unless a later work-group decision revises the compatibility policy.
issue_request: FHIR-36755 was a Published FHIR-core change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking the forward/backward compatibility Value Constraints rule to clarify that warning constraints/invariants do not affect compatibility or to qualify the invariant rule as applying to error constraints.
initial_application: The issue was applied in git commit f0b227068f110edc2debe58489dffa7f55488083, which changed source/versions.html to allow new warning or best practice invariants and to bound new error invariants. The current source still contains that language.
additional_context: FHIR-I May 2022 WGM minutes corroborate the decision and vote. Jira exact-term searches found only FHIR-36755, quoted Zulip searches found no relevant conflict, and source search found no parallel source location requiring another edit.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because source/versions.html already conveys the accepted distinction between warning/best-practice invariants and error invariants.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue requiring the compatibility Value Constraints rule to allow warning or best practice invariants.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes final WG intent: warning/best-practice invariants may be added, while error invariants are limited to newly introduced elements/codes or existing narrative rules.

evidence_items.summary: The current Value Constraints row says new warning or best practice invariants may be added and bounds new error invariants.
evidence_items.learned: The authoritative current source already contains the compatibility clarification requested by FHIR-36755.

evidence_items.summary: Commit f0b227068f110edc2debe58489dffa7f55488083 applied FHIR-36755 to source/versions.html.
evidence_items.learned: The existing source wording is traceable to a Jira-tagged application commit for this issue.

evidence_items.summary: FHIR-I minutes record the decision to clarify that warning constraints/invariants do not impact forward or backward compatibility, with vote 20-0-1.
evidence_items.learned: Meeting minutes corroborate the Jira disposition and do not broaden the required source change beyond the compatibility page.
